name: TimePlast TimeMass Detergent
filament_notes: TimeMass Detergent Filament Gen 6. Dry 68C/155F at least 2 h before every print. Use the external spool, not AMS. Print with the printer door open. Official nozzle is 0.8 mm. Vendor CryoGrip plate bed temperature is 75C (not mapped to a Bambu plate key). Assumption: cool, engineering and smooth high-temp plate temperatures are not published by the vendor and keep the Generic PLA template defaults. Safety: External use only; avoid eyes and sensitive areas; Stop if irritation; Gloves/eye protection handling fresh extrusion (Gen 5 SDS); Ventilate; Wet spills slippery; Avoid large discharge to waterways; No Gen 6 SDS verified. Use Gen 6 values only; do not use the gen5_reference values (Gen 5 differs in temperature, flow and bed).
